queries: GAIA benchmark November 2023 human 92 GPT-4 15 percent

sources_considered.why: Verifies the November 21, 2023 publication date and contemporaneous benchmark findings.
Primary benchmark paper comparing human performance with leading AI assistants.
November 21 release disclosure documents both improved capabilities and continuing factual errors.

receipt.public_excerpt: While humans excel at all levels, current best LLMs do poorly.

evidence_items.explanation: The November capability assessment reports approximately 92% success for humans versus 15% for GPT-4 with plugins on tasks combining reasoning, browsing, and information use. This supports a substantial shortfall beyond narrow machine strengths.

The newly released model improved factual accuracy and document comprehension but still produced false statements and incorrect answers. Its gains qualify any suggestion that AI lacked useful synthesis abilities, while supporting the narrower claim that the complete reliable capability had not arrived.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not measure the prevalence of public confusion or establish primitive knowledge as a causal explanation.
GAIA does not specify individual test-session dates; its event month represents the published November capability assessment.
The sources do not exhaustively test every AI system.
